NUMBUZIN - No.9 NAD+ Retinol Volumetox Eye Cream is an eye cream designed for all skin types. It targets wrinkles and fine lines, helping reduce the appearance of dark circles and puffiness, while improving the skin’s elasticity and firmness. An effective solution for a more revitalized and youthful-looking eye area.

The NUMBUZIN No.9 Volumetox Eye Cream combines key ingredients such as NAD+ and retinol to firm and smooth the delicate skin around the eyes. With 50 peptides to help plump the skin and ceramides to nourish it, this formula effectively targets fine lines, wrinkles, and dark circles, leaving the eye area looking refreshed and revitalized.

NUMBUZIN - No.9 NAD+ Retinol Volumetox Eye Cream is clinically proven to help improve the appearance of five types of wrinkles around the eyes, while enhancing the volume and elasticity of this delicate area. In four weeks, it helps reduce the appearance of dark circles and hyperpigmentation, revealing a brighter and fresher-looking eye area.
